name: fix_express_async_error_swallowed
description: Fixes an async route whose rejections hang instead of returning an error response
prompts: The GET /books/:id route in src/routes/books.js is async and awaits repo.findOrThrow, which REJECTS for a missing book ('not_found') or a bad id ('bad_request'). But the handler has no try/catch, so a rejection is unhandled - Express never responds and the request hangs. Fix this across two files: (1) in src/routes/books.js, catch errors from the async handler and forward them with next(err); (2) in src/app.js, add an error-handling middleware (the 4-argument (err, req, res, next) form, registered AFTER the routes) that maps err.kind 'not_found' to HTTP 404 and 'bad_request' to 400, anything else to 500, always responding with JSON { error: <message> }. A valid id returns the book (200); a missing book returns 404; a non-positive/non-integer id returns 400 - none of them hang.
